findings.title: sendFilePart 走 JSON base64 通道，违反 Notion send endpoint multipart/form-data 二进制契约
findings.evidence: Context7 /websites/developers_notion_reference: 'use a Content-Type of multipart/form-data and provide file contents under the file key. This method is unique to this endpoint; other Notion file upload APIs use JSON parameters.'
findings.impact: 每片 20MB base64 膨胀 33%→~27MB，100MB 文件 5 片分配 ~270MB 临时字符串；JSON.stringify 二次复制
findings.contract_requirement: multipart/form-data; boundary={boundary}, file field=binary, part_number field

findings.title: createMultiPartUpload 缺 number_of_parts 参数，违反 multi_part 契约
findings.evidence: Context7 OpenAPI: number_of_parts (integer 1-10000) required when mode=multi_part, must match final part_number
findings.impact: 可能触发 Notion API 400 bad request；当前实现未声明分片数

findings.title: multi_part 循环串行 + 无并发（契约允许 part 并发乱序）
findings.evidence: Context7: 'Parts can be sent concurrently up to Notion API rate limits and out of order'
findings.note: 本 issue 不修，归 PERF-002/ISS-017 范畴（并发改造需谨慎 + 速率限制处理）
